author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we once again look at how rapid emulation progress has been happening that in the span of a week we've had tons of projects decompiling and emulating major games we once thought would be playable at least a few years from now. GTA 6 doesn't seem like it will be too much trouble, once the files are dumped it's only a short matter of time. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We WILL Be Emulating GTA 6...
